description:
[Admin]

Checks an uploaded file and makes it usable. Reads the stored file: its real size, its first bytes against the declared type, the codec of a video (H.264 only, read from the file's stsd box), and an SVG for scripts, event attributes, javascript: addresses, foreignObject and outside links. A refused file is removed and the answer says why; nothing is rewritten. Replacing a file moves page drafts to the new address at once.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

duration_seconds.description: Length of a video or audio file in seconds.

height.description: Height in pixels of an image or video.

poster_url.description: Still image shown before a video plays: the `url` of an image in this company's library.

width.description: Width in pixels of an image or video.

name: Finish_uploading_a_media_file

drafts_updated.description: Page drafts moved to the new address when a file was replaced. Published pages keep the old address until they are published again.

alt.description: Alt text per language code, such as {"en": "Our team"}.

duration_seconds.description: Length of a video or audio file in seconds, as sent to media-upload-finish.

height.description: Height in pixels, as sent to media-upload-finish.

merchant_id.description: Company whose library holds the file.

poster_url.description: Still image shown before a video plays.

read_only.description: True for a file of the parent company's library: it can be used on pages but not changed or deleted.

size_bytes.description: Size of the file in bytes, measured after the upload.

status.description: uploading until media-upload-finish accepts the file, then ready.

url.description: Public address of the file, served by the CDN. It changes when the file is replaced.

version.description: Goes up each time the file is replaced.

width.description: Width in pixels, as sent to media-upload-finish.

replaced.description: True when this call swapped in a new version of an existing file. False on a new file, and when no replacement was waiting (a repeated call, or an upload that never arrived).

warnings.description: Things worth telling the person. The file was accepted.

title: Media Upload Finish
